title: 第5章  老天爷赏饭吃
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
林辰一脸冰寒，大步走来，目光之中煞气翻涌。
他痛恨陆渊。
不给他直升名额也就罢了，居然趁他不备将他打成重伤，差点耽误了他参加新血选拔。
还好林嫚儿找上了考官周通，周通看他资质上佳，送了一份疗伤灵药。
也因此，他因祸得福，伤势痊愈之后修为也突破到了凡境六层。
人群中，众多新人脸色一变，纷纷将目光看了过来。
“陆渊？他就是那个习武五年的凡境二层？”
“这种资质也能进镇魔司？”
“没听说吗？人家是有名额的。”
进入镇魔司以来，陆渊并没有过多的走动。
众多新人之所以能知晓他的底细，离不开林辰在暗地里推波助澜。
当然了，这一切也离不开周通的授意。
在他看来，让一个资质奇差的人进入镇魔司，这本身就是对斩妖除魔的玷污。
林辰没有多说，凡境六层的修为彻底爆发，探手成爪，直取陆渊咽喉。
“陆渊，今天我要你血债血......”
话还没说完。
陆渊出手，一拳砸出，一记重击逆势而上，直接轰在了林辰的胸口。
咔嚓，咔嚓......
胸骨凹陷，骨骼断裂的声音不断响起。
林辰一口鲜血喷出，还没反应过来，就以比来时更快的速度倒飞出去，重重跌在了锁妖井旁。

他倒在血泊中，口鼻之中不断溢出鲜血。
陆渊侧目看去，眼神漠然。
林辰浑身一颤，那双布满血丝的眼中满是恐惧，仿佛看到了什么凶神恶煞一般。
顾不得身上的疼痛，他连滚带爬地向后退去。
难以言喻的情绪充斥在他心中。
他怎么也想不明白，凡境六层的他怎么会挡不住陆渊随手一拳？
他连完整的招式都没用出，就被打成了重伤。
陆渊收回目光，没再搭理这种炮灰，迈步走向锁妖井。
周围众人如梦初醒，脸色复杂，不敢再有丝毫轻视，下意识向两边让开一条走道。
林辰是凡境六层，居然被一拳打成重伤。
这份修为......
凡境七层？还是八层？
这一刻，全场窒息。
就在这时，锁妖井旁的石碑上，一个名字突然出现。
陆渊，一息，两只妖魔。
很快，数字又跳动了一下。
三息，五只妖魔。
全场为之一惊，所有人的大脑在一瞬间陷入了空白。
什么情况？
正常考核中，斩杀一只妖魔少说也要一盏茶的功夫。

哪有几息几息的？
还让不让人活了？
一众新人们感到了强烈的危机，没再多说，纷纷进入锁妖井。
第三批考核，正式开始！
锁妖井下。
陆渊来到了狐妖领地。
数只牛犊大小的狐妖獠牙外露，眼眶里泛着绿光，咆哮着向陆渊扑杀而去。
陆渊猛地出拳，一记重击。
狐妖身躯直接炸开，黑血迸射，尸骨砸落在岩石之上。
【击杀凡境狐妖，获得白色词条[灵思]】
紧接着，他探手箍住一只狐妖脑袋，五指发力。
狐妖头颅碎裂，脑袋开花。
【击杀凡境狐妖，获得白色词条[灵思]】
甩去手上的红白血浆，陆渊眼神一片漠然。
难度太低了。
一群狐妖看着骇人，实际上也就是普通的凡境妖魔，与凡境武者相差不多。
在【开天】的加持下，这些妖魔对他根本造不成威胁。
他眼神平静，行走在狐妖群之中，举手投足之间一只只狐妖接连被打爆。
骨血齐飞，断肢四射，他姿态从容，上演着最极致的暴力美学。
【击杀凡境狐妖，获得白色词条[灵思]】

【击杀凡境狐妖，获得白色词条[灵思]】
【击杀凡境狐妖，获得白色词条[灵思]】
......
由于击杀的都是同一种狐妖，掉落的也是同样的词条，全都被收入词库之中。
一刻钟的时间，他就已经杀了七十九只狐妖。
主要是锁妖井下错综复杂，找怪多花了一些功夫。
否则以他的战力，击杀数量早就破百了。
看到这一恐怖战绩，外界的一众新人彻底凌乱了。
“一刻钟杀七十九只妖魔，你说他是凡境二层？”
“难怪一拳重伤林辰，这才是他真正的实力。”
“活该他直升，就这实力，他不直升我睡不着。”
“这怕不是要破纪录了，我可没听说过有人能在一刻钟杀八十只妖魔的。”
“看来青州镇魔司要出一个甲等战力了，入门就是镇魔校尉，前途无量啊！”
“考核时间一个时辰，你们说他能杀多少妖魔？”
“少说也三百往上走吧，天才都形容不了他，他是妖孽！”
“这下陆渊要出名了，青州谁人不识君啊！”
“咳咳咳咳......”
角落处，林辰不断咳血，脸色一片惨白，似乎随时都会断气过去。
陆渊一刻钟，比他一个时辰杀的妖魔还多。
这是人能做到的事？

你他妈才是妖魔吧！
他猛地喷出一口鲜血，心态彻底崩了。
锁妖井下，考核还在进行。
甲等战力对陆渊来说已经没有了悬念。
现在的他，只想在考核结束之前尽可能多的击杀狐妖。
根据系统机制，击杀同种妖魔会掉落相同词条，三个相同词条就能合成高级词条。
想要合成一个红词条，相同的白词条只需要243个，而不同的白词条却需要7776个。
在锁妖井下杀妖魔，对陆渊来说完全就是可遇不可求。
这种情况在外面根本遇不到。
外面的都是散妖，三五只，七八只，即便是妖魔聚众作乱，顶多也就是几十只。
就算一次性全杀光，撑死也就合成个蓝词，运气好能合成个紫词。
红词想都别想，除非杀进妖魔领地。
可是以他现在的实力，杀入妖魔领地完全就是找死。
这边刚杀几只小妖，一转眼初境妖魔就来了，都不用玄境大妖出马，一个照面他就得死。
可锁妖塔就不同了。
妖魔被圈养在其中，多年下来已经发展成了族群，数量庞大。
新人进入其中考核，凡境面对的就是凡境，不会突然冒出一只初境或者玄境的妖魔。
而且，不同族群的妖魔都被关在特定的区域，逃不了，只能在这片区域等着被杀。
这是什么？
老天爷赏饭吃！

陆渊杀入狐妖族群，重击之下招招毙命。
那些狐妖终于反应过来了，尖叫声四起，朝着四面八方的地洞逃窜。
陆渊追上去，一拳一个。
不过十几个呼吸，地上已经满是狐妖尸骨。
终于，考核结束。
陆渊甩去满手血浆，第一时间查看面板。
【当前词库：】
【灵思[白]×287】
【检测到可合成词条，是否合成？】
content_en:
Lin Chen strode over with a cold expression on his face, his eyes filled with evil energy.
He hated Lu Yuan.
It was enough not to give him a spot for direct promotion, but he was seriously injured when he was not prepared, which almost delayed his participation in the selection of new blood.
Fortunately, Lin Man'er found the examiner Zhou Tong. Seeing that he had excellent qualifications, Zhou Tong gave him a healing elixir.
Because of this, he was a blessing in disguise. After recovering from his injuries, his cultivation level also broke through to the sixth level of the mortal realm.
In the crowd, many newcomers' expressions changed and they all looked over.
"Lu Yuan? Is he the second-level mortal who has practiced martial arts for five years?"
"Can you enter the Demon-Suppressing Division with this kind of qualification?"
"Haven't you heard? There are quotas."
Since entering the Demon Suppression Division, Lu Yuan has not moved around much.
The reason why so many newcomers knew his details was because Lin Chen secretly contributed to the situation.
Of course, all this is inseparable from Zhou Tong's instruction.
In his opinion, allowing a person with extremely poor qualifications to enter the Demon Suppression Department is a stain on the Demon Slayer.
Lin Chen didn't say much, and his cultivation level at the sixth level of the mortal realm completely exploded, his hands turned into claws, and he went straight for Lu Yuan's throat.
"Lu Yuan, today I want your blood..."
The words are not finished yet.
Lu Yuan took action, punched out, and hit Lin Chen directly in the chest with a heavy blow.
Click, click...
The sternum was sunken, and the sound of broken bones continued to sound.
Lin Chen spurted out a mouthful of blood, and before he could react, he flew backwards at a faster speed than when he came in, and fell heavily next to the Demon Locking Well.
He fell in a pool of blood, and blood continued to flow from his mouth and nose.
Lu Yuan looked sideways, his eyes indifferent.
Lin Chen trembled all over, and his bloodshot eyes were full of fear, as if he had seen something sinister.
Ignoring the pain in his body, he rolled back and crawled back.
Unspeakable emotions filled his heart.
He couldn't understand why he, at the sixth level of the mortal realm, couldn't block Lu Yuan's casual punch?
He didn't even use the complete move before he was seriously injured.
Lu Yuan withdrew his gaze, ignored this cannon fodder, and walked towards the Demon Locking Well.
The people around him seemed to have just woken up from a dream, with complicated expressions on their faces. They did not dare to show any contempt anymore, and subconsciously moved to both sides to open a aisle.
Lin Chen was at the sixth level of the mortal realm and was seriously injured by a punch.
This cultivation...
Seventh level of mortal realm? Or the eighth floor?
At this moment, the whole audience was suffocated.
At this moment, a name suddenly appeared on the stone tablet next to the Suoyao Well.
Lu Yuan, one breath, two demons.
Soon, the number jumped again.
Three breaths, five demons.
The entire audience was shocked, and everyone's brains went blank for a moment.
What's going on?
In a normal assessment, it takes at least as long as a cup of tea to kill a demon.
How many breaths are there?
Are you going to let people live?
A group of newcomers felt a strong crisis, and without saying any more, they entered the Demon Locking Well one after another.
The third batch of assessments has officially begun!
Lock the demon underground.
Lu Yuan came to the fox demon territory.
Several calf-sized fox demons had their fangs exposed, their eyes glowing green, and they roared and charged towards Lu Yuan.
Lu Yuan punched hard and hit hard.
The body of the fox demon exploded directly, black blood burst out, and the bones fell on the rocks.
[Kill the mortal fox demon and obtain the white entry [Lingsi]]
Immediately afterwards, he put his hand around the head of a fox demon and exerted force with his five fingers.
The fox demon's head was broken into pieces and his brain blossomed.
[Kill the mortal fox demon and obtain the white entry [Lingsi]]
Shaking away the red and white blood on his hands, Lu Yuan's eyes were indifferent.
The difficulty is too low.
A group of fox monsters look scary, but in fact they are just ordinary mortal monsters, similar to mortal warriors.
With the blessing of [Open Heaven], these demons pose no threat to him at all.
His eyes were calm as he walked among the fox demons, and with every move he made, one by one the fox demons were shot to pieces.
Bones and blood are flying, broken limbs are flying, heWith a calm posture, he performs the most extreme aesthetics of violence.
[Kill the mortal fox demon and obtain the white entry [Lingsi]]
[Kill the mortal fox demon and obtain the white entry [Lingsi]]
[Kill the mortal fox demon and obtain the white entry [Lingsi]]
...
Since the same kind of fox demon was killed, the same entries were dropped, and they were all included in the vocabulary.
In a quarter of an hour, he had killed seventy-nine fox demons.
The main reason is that the monster lock underground is complicated and it takes a lot of effort to find the monsters.
Otherwise, with his combat power, the number of kills would have already exceeded 100.
Seeing this horrific record, the newcomers outside were completely confused.
"Seventy-nine demons were killed in a quarter of an hour. Do you think he is on the second level of the mortal realm?"
"No wonder Lin Chen was seriously injured with one punch. This is his true strength."
"He deserves to be promoted. With his strength, I can't sleep unless he is promoted."
"I'm afraid I'm not going to break the record. I've never heard of anyone being able to kill eighty demons in a quarter of an hour."
"It seems that the Qingzhou Demon Suppressing Division is about to produce a first-class combat force. The entry level is the Demon Suppressing School Captain. The future is bright!"
"The assessment lasts for one hour. How many demons do you think he can kill?"
"Stop talking and go up three hundred. A genius can't even describe him. He is a monster!"
"Now Lu Yuan is going to be famous. Who in Qingzhou doesn't recognize you!"
"Cough cough cough cough..."
In the corner, Lin Chen kept coughing up blood, his face turned pale, and he seemed to be dying at any moment.
Lu Yuan killed more demons in a quarter of an hour than he did in an hour.
Is this something a human can do?
You are the fucking monster!
He spat out a mouthful of blood, his mentality completely shattered.
Under the Lock Demon Well, the assessment is still going on.
There is no suspense for Lu Yuan about Class A combat power.
Now, he just wants to kill as many fox demons as possible before the test is over.
According to the system mechanism, killing the same kind of monster will drop the same entry, and three identical entries can be synthesized into advanced entries.
To synthesize a red entry, only 243 identical white entries are needed, while 7776 different white entries are needed.
Killing demons in the Demon Locking Well was a rare opportunity for Lu Yuan.
This kind of situation is simply not encountered outside.
There are all loose demons outside, three to five, seven or eight. Even if the demons gather to cause chaos, there will only be dozens at most.
Even if you kill them all at once, you will only be able to synthesize a blue word if you fight to the death. If you are lucky, you can synthesize a purple word.
Don't even think about the red words, unless you enter the demon territory.
But with his current strength, entering the demon's territory is simply courting death.
We just killed a few little demons here, and in a blink of an eye, the demon from the first level is here. There is no need for the big demon from the mysterious realm to take action. He will die as soon as he meets him.
But the Demon Locking Tower is different.
The demons were kept in captivity, and over the years they have developed into a huge population.
When a newcomer enters the assessment, the mortal realm will face the mortal realm, and a demon from the primary realm or the mysterious realm will not suddenly appear.
Moreover, demons from different groups are locked in specific areas. They cannot escape and can only wait to be killed in this area.
What's this?
God will reward you with food!
Lu Yuan rushed into the fox demon group and was killed by all the heavy blows.
The fox monsters finally reacted, screaming and running towards the caves in all directions.
Lu Yuan chased after him, punching each one.
Within a dozen breaths, the ground was already covered with fox demon corpses.
Finally, the assessment is over.
Lu Yuan shook off his hands full of plasma and immediately checked the panel.
